PlectaDepthRuleLegacyFloor.what: the removed rule's fixed denominator floor

PlectaDepthRuleSaturationCut.what: score at which the removed rule became unable to abstain

PlectaDepthRuleSatSynthPct.what: per cent of synthetic crossings at that saturation

PlectaDepthRuleSatRealPct.what: per cent of real crossings at that saturation

PlectaDepthRuleSatBelowNoiseAcc.what: accuracy of saturated crossings below the noise floor

PlectaDepthRuleSatAboveNoiseAcc.what: accuracy of saturated crossings above it

PlectaDepthRuleSharpDecidedPct.what: per cent of crossings the removed sharpness channel decided alone

PlectaDepthRuleSharpKappa.what: its agreement with the intensity channel

PlectaDepthRuleAxialDelta.what: the axial channel, measured inert and not included
